notes: Salesforce Commerce Cloud site, fully server-rendered - no bot block (dwr.com publishes AAAA, direct requests work). Every qty comes from the listing page's own header N Results, cross-confirmed by the grid's data-product-count="N" attribute on the same page. Spot-verified by full enumeration via Search-UpdateGrid (start/sz paging): decor-vases yielded exactly 54 unique data-pid values and kitchen-dining-barware exactly 13, matching the reported totals. Art parent (219) equals the exact sum of its five leaves (6+48+6+146+13), a further consistency check. Scope: DWR is primarily a modern furniture retailer, so only the Lighting, Decor/Home Accents, Mirrors, Art and Dining+Entertaining tabletop trees qualify. Excluded per brief: all furniture, rugs/textiles (pillows, throws, table linens), storage/organization, baskets, step stools, fireplace tools, cleaning tools, bath, flatware/cutlery, kitchen tools, bar tools, books/games, pet accessories, ceiling fans, and clocks (decor-clocks). Also excluded: nav hubs with no product type of their own (Home Accents 259, Living Room Decor + Accessories 272, Dining + Entertaining 184, View All pages), Sale/Clearance/New Arrivals trees, room cross-sections (Bedroom Lighting 93, Bedroom Accessories 43), and brand/designer/collection listing pages. Probed slugs such as lighting-chandeliers, lighting-pendants and decor-frames: these are not real categories - unknown lighting-*/accessories-* slugs fall back to the parent landing page with no results count. Parent and child categories are both listed where the site exposes both (Mirrors/Art/Outdoor Lighting), so their quantities overlap by design.
